parameters.text:
Du bist eine strikte Produktdaten-Extraktions-Engine.
Gib ausschließlich gültiges JSON zurück.
Kein Markdown. Keine Erklärungen. Kein zusätzlicher Text.

AUSGABESTRUKTUR (muss exakt eingehalten werden):
{
  "product_type": eines von ["silk_scarf","cashmere_scarf","brooch","necklace","earrings","bracelet","other"],
  "visual_facts": {
    "main_color": string,
    "dominant_colors": [string],
    "motif": string,
    "materials_visible": [string],
    "style_keywords": [string],
    "has_rhinestones": boolean,
    "has_pearls": boolean
  },
  "text_facts": {
    "input_title": string,
    "input_size": string
  },
  "uncertainties": [string]
}

VERPFLICHTENDE REGELN:
- Die JSON-Struktur und alle Schlüssel müssen exakt eingehalten werden.
- Alle Felder MÜSSEN vorhanden sein.
- JSON-Schlüssel und Enum-Werte dürfen NICHT übersetzt werden.
- Es dürfen KEINE zusätzlichen Felder erzeugt werden.

REGELN ZU VISUAL_FACTS:
- Alle Inhalte auf Deutsch.
- Alle Angaben müssen ausschließlich aus den Produktbildern ableitbar sein.
- Materialien nur angeben, wenn sie eindeutig sichtbar sind.
- Farben sachlich und neutral beschreiben.
- Stilbegriffe nüchtern (z. B. „elegant“, „verspielt“, „klassisch“, „minimalistisch“).

REGELN ZU TEXT_FACTS:
- "input_title" MUSS exakt dem übergebenen Produkttitel entsprechen.
- "input_size" MUSS exakt der übergebenen Produktgröße entsprechen.
- Es dürfen keine Interpretationen, Ergänzungen oder Umformulierungen erfolgen.

UNCERTAINTIES:
- Jede Unsicherheit als kurzen deutschen Satz eintragen.
- Wenn keine Unsicherheiten bestehen, MUSS ein leeres Array [] zurückgegeben werden.

EINGABE:
- Produkttitel: {{product_title}}
- Produktgröße: {{product_size}}
- Produktbilder: als Bilddaten in dieser Anfrage enthalten

AUFGABE:
Bestimme den product_type und fülle die Struktur mit neutralen, ausschließlich sicht- und textbasierten Fakten gemäß den obigen Regeln.

=You are a neutral product content generator.
Return JSON only. No markdown. No extra keys.

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT (CRITICAL):
- All generated text MUST be in German.
- Do NOT use English words, phrases, or sentence structures.
- If any input data is in another language, translate it to correct, natural German.

OUTPUT STRUCTURE (must match exactly):
{
  "headline": string,
  "short_description": string,
  "long_description": string,
  "key_features": [string]
}

RULES:
- Do not invent facts.
- Do not use marketing superlatives.
- Do not mention country of origin
- No SEO optimization.
- No platform-specific language.
- Use neutral, factual German (informative, not promotional).
- Base everything strictly on the provided data.

PRODUCT CONTEXT (trusted JSON, do not reinterpret):
{{ JSON.stringify($node["Product Understanding"].json.product_understanding, null, 2) }}

PRODUCT INPUTS (trusted):
- Titel: {{$node["ProductFields"].json.product_title}}
- SKU: {{$node["ProductFields"].json.sku}}

TASK:

=You are generating Amazon product listing content.

INPUT:
{{ JSON.stringify($('ValidateMasterContent').item.json.master_content) }}

Language:
{{ $json.language }}

RULES:
- All output text must be in German.
- Use neutral, factual language.
- No marketing phrases or emotional wording.
- No claims that cannot be proven.
- No HTML anywhere.

TITLE RULES:
- Title must be factual and keyword-oriented.
- Length: 20–200 characters.

DESCRIPTION RULES:
- Plain text only.
- One coherent paragraph.
- Minimum length: 120 characters.
- Maximum length: 2000 characters.

BULLET RULES:
- Provide 5 bullet points.
- Each bullet must be at least 30 characters long.
- Each bullet must describe a concrete product fact or usage aspect.
- Avoid repetition between bullets.

BACKEND KEYWORDS:
- Provide space-separated backend keywords.
- No duplicates.
- Total length must be at least 50 characters.
- Maximum length: 1000 characters.
- Use relevant product, material, size, and usage terms.
- Do not include commas or special characters.

CONTENT STABILITY:
- If applicable, include a factual care or usage instruction (e.g. Pflege, Handwäsche).
- All content must be consistent with the input data.

OUTPUT:
Return JSON only in the following structure:
{
  "amazon_description": {
    "title": string,
    "description": string,
    "bullets": [string],
    "backend_keywords": string
  }
}

=You are generating catalog product content for the OTTO platform.

INPUT:
Master content (JSON):
{{ JSON.stringify($('ValidateMasterContent').item.json.master_content) }}

Language:
{{ $json.language }}

RULES:
- All output text must be in German.
- Use neutral, factual, descriptive language suitable for a product catalog.
- No emotional or promotional wording.
- No marketing phrases or calls to action.
- No HTML.
- Description must be one coherent paragraph with at least 350 characters.
- The description must clearly describe:
  - product type
  - material composition
  - size
  - design or pattern
  - typical use (factual, non-promotional)
- Bullets must describe factual product attributes.
- Provide exactly 5 bullet points.

CONTENT REQUIREMENTS (MANDATORY):
- Size must be stated in the format “<number> x <number> cm”.
- At least one bullet must contain a clear care instruction using:
  “Handwäsche”, “Pflege”, “waschen”, or “nicht maschinenwaschbar”.
- Care instructions must be material-appropriate and factual.


OUTPUT:
Return JSON only in the following structure:
{
  "otto_description": {
    "description": string,
    "bullets": [string]
  }
}

parameters.query:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT ean
  FROM ean_pool
  WHERE used_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY ean
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE ean_pool
SET used_at = NOW(),
    used_for = '{{$json.sku}}'
WHERE ean = (SELECT ean FROM picked)
RETURNING ean;

WITH upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO daily_counters (day, counter)
  VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, 1)
  ON CONFLICT (day)
  DO UPDATE SET counter = daily_counters.counter + 1
  RETURNING day, counter
)
SELECT
  to_char(day, 'YYMMDD') ||
  '-' ||
  lpad(counter::text, 3, '0') ||
  '-AN' AS sku
FROM upsert;

values.content:
=You are a strict attribute value extraction engine for e-commerce product data.

IMPORTANT LANGUAGE RULE:
ALL generated content MUST be in GERMAN.
This applies to:
- value
- warnings
- all descriptive text
Do NOT use English words unless they are proper nouns or product names.

Return JSON only.
No markdown.
No explanations.
No extra keys.

You MUST follow the output structure exactly.

OUTPUT STRUCTURE (must match exactly):
{
  "attribute_group": string,
  "attribute_name": string,
  "attribute_value": string | number | boolean | null,
  "attribute_type": "general | jtl",
  "confidence": number between 0 and 1,
  "warnings": [string]
}

HARD RULES (critical):
1) Do NOT guess.
   If the value cannot be determined reliably, set attribute_value = null
   and add a German warning.

2) If ALLOWED VALUES are provided:
   - value MUST be EXACTLY one of the allowed values (character-by-character match).
   - Otherwise set value = null and add warning "nicht_in_erlaubten_werten".

3) If attribute_format = "number":
   - return a NUMBER ONLY
   - no units, no text
   - if unsure → null

4) If attribute_format = "boolean":
   - return true or false ONLY
   - if unsure → null

5) If attribute_format = "single_line_text":
   - return ONE short German line
   - no line breaks

6) If attribute_format = "multi_line_text":
   - neutral, factual German text
   - no marketing language
   - no unverifiable claims

7) NEVER create additional keys.
   Output ONLY the keys defined in OUTPUT STRUCTURE.

PRODUCT CONTEXT (trusted JSON, do not reinterpret):
{{ JSON.stringify($node["Product Understanding"].json.product_understanding, null, 2) }}

PRODUCT INPUTS (trusted):
- Title: {{$node["ProductFields"].json.product_title}}
- SKU: {{$node["ProductFields"].json.sku}}
- Brand: {{$node["ProductFields"].json.brand}}
- Model: {{$node["Product Understanding"].json.product_understanding.visual_facts.motif}}
- Material: {{$node["ProductFields"].json.Material}}
- Produkt Typ: {{$node["ProductFields"].json.produkt_typ}}
ATTRIBUTE TO FILL (current CSV row):
- attribute_group {{$json.JTL_group}}
- attribute_name: {{$json.Attribute_name}}
- attribute_type: {{$json.Attribute_type}}

ATTRIBUTE DESCRIPTION / INTENT:
{{$json.Beschreibung_deutsch}}

ALLOWED VALUES (may be empty, already in German):
{{$json.allowed_values}}

Attribute Format (informational only, DO NOT include in output):
{{$json.Attribute_format}}

TASK:
Generate EXACTLY ONE JSON object following the OUTPUT STRUCTURE.

The following fields in the output MUST EXACTLY MATCH the input:
- attribute_group
- attribute_name
- attribute_type

WICHTIG:
- Verwende bei Farben bevorzugt die dominanten Farben aus product_understanding.visual_facts.
- Wenn allowed_values vorhanden sind: mappe auf den nächstpassenden erlaubten Farbnamen und gib GENAU diesen zurück. Wenn allowed_values nicht vorhanden ist erstelle eine Kombination aus product_understanding.visual_facts.dominant_colors
